In _anchor_without_a_crossing, the 'seen' dict-and-sort is replaced by builds = _with_named(named + _build_commits(...), _named_build_commits(...)). measured_files is the existing comprehension [f for f in files if _classify(f, ...) is None]. Nothing after builds changes. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
